{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load and clean data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')
trial_df.columns = ['patient_id', 'sample_seq', 'site', 'arm', 'severity', 'age', 'sex', 'assay_batch', 'biomarker_baseline', 'biomarker_final', 'responded']

# Compute the difference in response rates between sexes within each treatment arm
# Control group
control_F_rate = trial_df[(trial_df['sex'] == 'F') & (trial_df['arm'] == 'control')]['responded'].mean()
control_M_rate = trial_df[(trial_df['sex'] == 'M') & (trial_df['arm'] == 'control')]['responded'].mean()
control_diff = control_F_rate - control_M_rate

# Treatment group
treatment_F_rate = trial_df[(trial_df['sex'] == 'F') & (trial_df['arm'] == 'treatment')]['responded'].mean()
treatment_M_rate = trial_df[(trial_df['sex'] == 'M') & (trial_df['arm'] == 'treatment')]['responded'].mean()
treatment_diff = treatment_F_rate - treatment_M_rate

# Compute overall difference in response rates by sex
overall_diff = trial_df[trial_df['sex'] == 'F']['responded'].mean() - trial_df[trial_df['sex'] == 'M']['responded'].mean()

print(f'Control group: F vs M response rate difference = {control_diff}')
print(f'Treatment group: F vs M response rate difference = {treatment_diff}')
print(f'Overall: F vs M response rate difference = {overall_diff}')

# Check baseline biomarker difference
biomarker_F = trial_df[trial_df['sex'] == 'F']['biomarker_baseline'].mean()
biomarker_M = trial_df[trial_df['sex'] == 'M']['biomarker_baseline'].mean()
biomarker_diff = biomarker_F - biomarker_M

print(f'Baseline biomarker difference (F - M): {biomarker_diff}')"}
